title: From idea to production
subtitle: Six explicit gates keep every change reviewable and safe.

steps.name: Plan
steps.detail: Define scope and acceptance criteria. Gate: Scope ready.

steps.name: Build
steps.detail: Implement the smallest complete change. Gate: Checks pass.

steps.name: Review
steps.detail: Validate correctness, clarity, and risk. Gate: Approved.

steps.name: Test
steps.detail: Exercise behavior in a safe environment. Gate: Verified.

steps.name: Canary
steps.detail: Release narrowly and observe signals. Gate: Healthy.

steps.name: Production
steps.detail: Expand confidently with rollback ready. Gate: Shipped.

footer: Every stage earns the next one — a change that fails a gate stays put until the gate passes.
